sloka: पुनरेवागतस्त्रस्तस्त्वकाशमरिन्दम ।स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम् ।। ५.६७.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: punarevāgatastrastastvakāśamarindama ।sa taṁ nipatitaṁ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam ।। 5.67.15 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O destroyer of enemies the crow came back again to you trembling seeking protection from you and fell on the ground. Even though it deserved to be slayed, you saved him out of compassion.
